context: Aoi and Mei reminisce about high-school days.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ベッド/タイミング/新宿/高校生/解放) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 高校生の頃、よく新宿で遊んだなあ。
lines.en: As a high schooler, I often hung out in Shinjuku.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私もだよ。あの解放感、懐かしいね。
lines.en: Me too. That sense of freedom — nostalgic.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: テスト明けの、タイミングが最高だったね。
lines.en: The timing after exams was the best.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 遊び疲れて、ベッドで爆睡したよ。
lines.en: Worn out from playing, I crashed in bed.
lines.style: giggly woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新宿の街、今も変わらないかな。
lines.en: I wonder if Shinjuku's still the same.
lines.style: wistful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいタイミングで、また行こうよ。
lines.en: Let's go again at a good time.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 高校生に戻った気分に、なれるね。
lines.en: We could feel like high schoolers again.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 日々から解放されて、楽しもうね。
lines.en: Freed from the daily grind, let's have fun.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
